name: How to Get Espers
source:
"A chase after we first meet and a huge brawl in the middle of our date....."
"Get to the point."
"Someone asked me to teach them with my body."
"…Can you explain the middle part a little?"

Even though Murphy can even see things that move at the speed of light, they look like an ordinary person so they can't even use their powers. Murphy gets caught up in some strange events and meets some even stranger espers....

How can I get it?

…

What.... is "it" that they'll get?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.howtoget.espers.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“我们第一次见面后的一场追逐，以及约会过程中的一场激烈争吵……”
“进入正题吧。”
“有人要求我用我的身体来教导他们。”
“……你能稍微解释一下中间部分吗？”

尽管墨菲甚至可以看到以光速移动的物体，但它们看起来就像一个普通人，所以他们甚至无法使用他们的力量。墨菲陷入了一些奇怪的事件，并遇到了一些更奇怪的超能力者……

我怎样才能得到它？

……

他们会得到什么……“它”？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.howtoget.espers.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
